name: code-review
description: Read-only code review of a repo path with prioritized findings
goal: Review the code in {repo} (read only). Focus: {focus}.
constraints: Do not modify anything under {repo}; you may only read it. Write review.md in the job directory: summary, then findings ordered by severity (file:line, problem, suggested fix). Max 25 findings. Never copy secrets you find; just flag their location.
done_when: review.md exists with a summary and severity-ordered findings that reference real files/lines in {repo}.
